tidemarkcap-jane-app:ashbyhq:7fe871c5-3f.description: Hi, I'm Raj https://www.linkedin.com/in/raj-paul-a8b4461/, and I'm the Engineering Leader for Jane AI alongside my colleague, Thibaut https://www.linkedin.com/in/thibautc/. We're hiring a Staff Mobile Developer to join our team. Jane AI is a new team operating inside Jane as a startup. Our mission is to transform Jane into a lasting AI-first offering that leads our industry, in the shared pursuit of "helping the helpers." There are currently eight of us - designers and developers - running several work streams including our own AI infrastructure and Jane Companion, an AI-first, mobile-first product that rethinks practice management from scratch. Not Jane with AI bolted on. A fundamentally new way for practitioners to manage their clinics, powered by AI that understands allied health workflows at a deep level. Our new Staff Mobile Developer is central to making Companion real. We need a deeply experienced mobile engineer who can own the architecture from the ground up, solve hard problems around performance, offline, audio/AI pipelines, and mentor our team as we continue to discover new opportunities. If you're energized by building something new at the intersection of mobile and AI, we'd love to talk. WHAT IMPACT WE'RE LOOKING FOR YOU TO MAKE - Own the architecture and technical direction of the Jane AI mobile experience, making foundational decisions that set the product up to scale as we move from early customers to broad adoption across thousands of clinics. - Drive critical performance improvements across our AI and audio pipelines - reducing latency, optimizing streaming, and ensuring that AI-generated content feels instant and reliable in fast-paced clinical workflows. - Build offline sync capabilities and foundational data architecture so that our mobile product works seamlessly in real-world clinical environments where connectivity is inconsistent and patient data must remain secure. - Break down complex challenges - from healthcare data security compliance to AI integration patterns - into clear technical plans, working closely with your team and cross-functional partners to deliver iteratively. WHAT EXPERIENCE WE NEED - 10+ years of software engineering experience, with the majority spent in mobile development, including production React Native applications shipped at scale. - Deep native expertise with real architectural depth - someone who can go beyond framework limitations when the situation demands it. - Demonstrated ownership of mobile performance as a system-level concern, including defining SLOs, building monitoring and observability and preventing regressions across releases. - Experience mentoring senior engineers and helping them grow toward staff-level scope and influence, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high craft. - Strong familiarity with the React Native ecosystem and tooling. - Experience with LLM API integration, on-device ML, or feature flag platforms. MORE ABOUT JANE Jane is practice management software loved by allied health practitioners, from physiotherapists and counsellors to chiropractors and massage therapists. We grew entirely through word of mouth. No sales team. Just a product people loved enough to tell their colleagues about. Today, Jane supports over 65,000 clinics in 60 countries and we have over 1,000 new clinics joining Jane every month. We're profitable, north of $1.8B in valuation and remote-first. That combination, organic growth, real scale, real revenue, is rarer than it sounds. We're now in the middle of our most significant chapter yet. AI is changing what software can do, and we're leaning in hard, both in how our team works and in what we build for our customers. A NOTE ON PACE Jane.ai http://Jane.ai is in a different season than most teams. We're chasing product-market fit with urgency. The pace is faster, the ambiguity is higher, and we lean in when it counts. It's not forever, but it's where we are right now. If you're energized...

uppartners-hermeus:lever:0bbccbd5-2468-4.title: Lead Propulsion Component Engineer
uppartners-hermeus:lever:0bbccbd5-2468-4.description: Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage. As a Lead Propulsion Component Engineer you will own the development of flight-critical propulsion components—including valves, actuators, and high-performance mechanical systems operating in extreme thermal and pressure environments. This is a player–coach role: you will directly design and deliver hardware while leading a small team of engineers. You will own components from clean-sheet design through test, qualification, and flight, and your hardware will move quickly from concept to real-world operation.

usv-tucows:greenhouse:7764168003.description: Ting Internet is a leading fiber Internet provider in the United States, delivering future-proof internet in over a dozen Ting Towns across the country. As part of Tucows (NASDAQ:TCX, TSX:TC), Ting is backed by outstanding resources and talent. We embrace a people-first philosophy that is rooted in respect, trust, and flexibility. We believe that whatever works for our employees is what works best for us. It’s also why the majority of our roles are remote-first, meaning you can work from anywhere you can connect to the internet! The work we do genuinely changes lives. If this sounds exciting, we’d love to hear from you! About the opportunity The Service Technician regularly performs service activation and installs of the Ting fiber network to include construction elements such as conduit, fiber, split enclosures, cabinets and utility locating. Service Techs are at the forefront of Ting’s connection with the community and perform their responsibilities with safety and customer experience top of mind. This role is based out of New Castle, CO. This is a 6 month contract to start with an opportunity to extend. Job Duties Performing general installation of fiber network, including connecting, disconnecting, testing, repairing and maintaining the fiber network. Directly engaging with customers at install locations to ensure timely, efficient and optimal activation/connectivity. Completing installs with knowledge of different installation tactics, including optimal utility placements related to wall fishing. Ability to perform fiber drops on site from handhole to house with supervision. Understand the mainline and drop-blowing process and assist teams with supervision. Understand basic concepts of the data center and its components. Ability to perform basic troubleshooting to identify connectivity issues from home to handhole. Build a splice dome and express dome installation with supervision. Understand conduit continuity and light level testing to perform installs, with the ability to identify connectivity issues. Complete general repair of the network including troubleshooting at the NID/home/handhold. Basic understanding of Utility locates. All other duties as assigned. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Customer interaction Drops/Installation FTTH Installation Fiber Splicing- 1 splice at the house, tying plant to outlet + drop splicing Cable Routing Power tools Ability to participate in on-call rotation Ability to work in confined spaces. Ability to do aerial work on a ladder or bucket truck up to 35’ . Ability to lift up to 75 pounds while practicing safe lifting techniques Ability to work indoors and outdoors in all types of weather conditions, with provided weather protection materials. Proficient with all platforms and applications (ServiceMax, Bob, Deputy, etc) Compliance with all safety related training/practises, including but not limited to ladder safety, weather, safe driving principles, etc. Qualifications Required 0-2 years of experience, preferably in telecommunications industry Active valid drivers license and clean drivers abstract The base salary range for this position is $53,372 - $60,000. Range shown in $USD for US residents. Other countries will differ. Range may vary on a number of factors including, but not limited to: location, experience and qualifications. Tucows believes in a total rewards offering that includes fair compensation and generous benefits. Learn more about Tucows Benefits. As a safety sensitive position, Tucows reserves the right to administer pre-employment drug testing for illegal drug use for those successful candidates presented with an offer of employment for consideration. verdane-wunderflats:greenhouse:479770310.description: Here you can find our German speaking jobs. ABOUT US Wunderflats helps people find fully furnished homes for a month or more, perfect for relocations, family moves, or life transitions. It offers a secure and seamless rental experience across Europe. Founded in Berlin in 2015 by Jan Hase and Arkadi Jampolski, Wunderflats bridges the gap between verified landlords and carefully vetted tenants. As part of Europe’s housing infrastructure, it helps activate underutilized apartments and support the evolving ways people live and work today. More than 63,000 apartments are currently listed, and the company employs a team of over 150 people. Learn more at www.wunderflats.com . Als Key Account Manager (w/m/d) bist du bei Wunderflats die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere wichtigsten professionellen Vermieter. Du sorgst dafür, dass ihr Portfolio optimal performt, Prozesse reibungslos laufen und sowohl Vermieter als auch Mieter eine erstklassige Erfahrung haben. Deine Aufgabe ist es, langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen, gemeinsam mit deinen Vermietern zu wachsen und Wunderflats als Partner erster Wahl im flexiblen Wohnungsmarkt zu positionieren. DEINE AUFGABEN Du verantwortest die Performance großer, professioneller Vermieter und sorgst dafür, dass ihr Portfolio kontinuierlich wächst und rentabel bleibt. Du identifizierst, gewinnst und integrierst neue professionelle Anbieter auf unserer Plattform. Du begleitest sie aktiv durch die ersten Buchungen und stellst sicher, dass sie von Anfang an eine großartige Erfahrung mit Wunderflats haben. Du baust langfristige, strategische Beziehungen zu deinen Vermietern auf, agierst als Trusted Advisor und stellst sicher, dass beide Seiten – Vermieter und Mieter – von der Zusammenarbeit profitieren. Du gestaltest Prozesse gemeinsam mit Vermietern und internen Teams, um Buchungen effizient und kundenfreundlich abzuwickeln. Du nutzt KPIs und Portfolio-Analysen, um Wachstumschancen zu erkennen, Optimierungen voranzutreiben und Handlungsempfehlungen für Produkt- und Prozessverbesserungen abzuleiten. Dein Fokus liegt auf exzellentem Service – Mieter, Vermieter und Wunderflats profitieren gleichermaßen von deinen Entscheidungen und Maßnahmen. DEIN PROFIL Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1) und sehr gutes Englisch (B2). Du hast Erfahrung im Management komplexer Kundenbeziehungen, idealerweise im Immobilien- oder Plattform-Business. Du verstehst, wie professionelle Vermieter denken und welche Prozesse und KPIs ihr Geschäft steuern. Strategisches Denken gepaart mit Hands-on-Mentalität: Du setzt Maßnahmen um und denkst gleichzeitig langfristig. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du verhandelst sicher, löst Konflikte und baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf. Analytisches Verständnis: Du erkennst Muster im Portfolio, nutzt KPIs zur Priorisierung und steuerst Wachstum datenbasiert. Leidenschaft für exzellenten Service: Du willst, dass Mieter und Vermieter bei Wunderflats einfach begeistert sind. UNSER PITCH #EmpathyCulture: Werde Teil eines internationalen Teams, in dem deine Ideen zählen und deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewirkt. Von Anfang an bist du in bedeutende Projekte eingebunden. #Onboarding und Training : Wir bieten dir einen strukturierten Onboarding-Prozess und eine persönliche Einarbeitung, damit du dich schnell einfindest und erfolgreich durchstarten kannst. #WorkLifeBalance : Unsere Arbeitszeiten sind flexibel und familienfreundlich. Wir arbeiten nach einem hybriden Modell mit festen Büro-Tagen. #WunderOffice : Erlebe unser modernes Berliner Büro, das auf Zusammenarbeit und Kreativität ausgelegt ist – mit ergonomischen Arbeitsplätzen, einem Spielraum, einer Dachterrasse sowie kostenlosem Obst, einer DIY-Müslibar und Getränken zur Stärkung. #WeLoveToHaveFun: Ob Teambuilding-Aktivitäten oder unsere Sommer- und Winterpartys – wir schaffen eine unterhaltsame und inklusive Atmosphäre, in der du dich mit deinen Kolleg:innen vernetzen kannst. #MoreBenefits : Profitiere von Vergünstigungen für eine Urban S...

yc-gitlab:greenhouse:8523640002.title: Executive Assistant
yc-gitlab:greenhouse:8523640002.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As an Executive Assistant, you will help the VP of Business Systems, VP of Support, and VP of Data stay focused on the highest-impact work. This role creates leverage by bringing structure to fast-moving priorities, managing critical logistics, and making sure information, next steps, and follow-through stay on track in a dynamic, all-remote environment. You will work closely with these three executives while partnering closely with a broader network of Executive Assistants across GitLab. This is a strong fit if you enjoy turning ambiguity into clarity, using tools and systems to keep work moving, and anticipating needs before they become urgent. In your first year, you'll build strong working relationships, create reliable operating rhythms for each executive, and improve calendar management, travel coordination, reporting, meeting planning, recruiting coordination, and team logistics. You will also use AI tools to streamline routine work and improve information synthesis so the VPs can make better choices, faster. What you’ll do Support the VP of Business Systems, VP of Support, and VP of Data across scheduling, logistics, communication, and day-to-day execution so priorities stay on track and follow-through is clear. Manage complex calendars by vetting requests, prioritizing meetings, proactively managing conflicting calendar times, recommending tradeoffs, ensuring appropriate spacing between meetings and breaks, and aligning schedules with GitLab meeting norms and practices to protect time for highest-impact work. Prepare complete agendas from high-level meeting descriptions and linked materials so leaders are ready for internal and external meetings with the right context and decisions. Maintain regular communication cadences with both leaders and proactively flag items that need review, decisions, or escalation so urgent issues are surfaced on time. Track updates from direct reports, functional peers, and cross-functional partners so leaders have clear visibility into progress, dependencies, and upcoming deliverables. Coordinate travel, including air and ground transportation, hotel bookings, visas, security-related needs, and supporting documentation so plans are accurate and ready when needed. Process expense reports, monitor reimbursements, and handle administrative workflows with accuracy and timeliness so expenses stay current and compliant.
